title: Frozen cross-dataset confirmation on Stanford Dogs

data.source: Khosla et al., CVPR Workshop 2011 official ImageNetDogs images.tar and train_list.mat
data.forbidden_split: test_list.mat must not be loaded by preparation or extraction code
data.episode_overlap: zero; select 30 official-train images per class once and partition into three groups of ten

method_and_baselines: all DCTPR, TIM-ADM, MAP/PT-MAP, and LaplacianShot constants frozen from PAT-K-260729-004; no Dogs labels select hyperparameters
primary_metric: mean balanced accuracy across three episodes and ten support rotations

paper_level_gate.practical_gain: DCTPR improves BL nearest support by at least 3.0 percentage points in every Dogs episode
paper_level_gate.published_competitiveness: DCTPR mean is no more than 1.0 percentage point below the strongest frozen published baseline
paper_level_gate.stability: DCTPR is positive versus BL nearest support in all 30 paired rotations
paper_level_gate.on_pass: paper-level empirical route GO; manuscript drafting may start while official test remains optional and locked
paper_level_gate.on_fail: report CUB-specific limitation and do not claim cross-dataset method validation

official_test_access: CUB and Stanford Dogs official test images remain unread and unencoded
